posts.title: Sunrise in Boston
posts.description: I was on a work trip to Boston recently and one of the benefits of jetlag is that you wake up early enough to be able to get out and take photos on the sunrise. When I first got out I didn’t think I was going to get anything good because of the clouds but in the end the clouds were perfectly spaced to reflect the early morning sun and light up the harbour.

posts.title: A dream of a robin
posts.description: Normally what I look for in photos is sharp focus. I want to make out every detail. But as I was editing this photo of a robin perched in a magnolia bush I found the background turning all milky and making it all look dreamlike. So I leaned into it and in the end this might be one of the best photos I’ve ever taken.
